policy_steps: Detect missing or stale wrapper completion receipt after the configured gate.
Run existing-lane app probe only; do not create replacement lanes.
Redact app receipt thread metadata before publication.
Run direct existing-thread completion notifier when probe shows callable routes are healthy.
Run direct repair gate and five-lane normalizer before allowing phase advance.
Record the wrapper-layer gap as a stale-flow repair target even when direct completion succeeds.
not_allowed: New thread or replacement sibling creation
